queries.query:
MATCH (root:WorkGraphRootIssue)
MATCH (definition:WorkflowDefinition {workflowDefinitionId: 'issue-lifecycle', digest: 'sha256:692a4ff45cfffcf1dc3462fcd3d904656a4c03efe7b598a09acdf368ce0d6645'})-[:HAS_TASK]->(target:TaskDefinition {taskDefinitionId: 'wgd-2ce0abc2104478fd27e0edeec7173ad089f6f2fb72c02694bc2525146cfe'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (run:WorkflowRun)-[:RUN_FOR]->(root)
WITH root, definition, target, count(run) AS runCount
WHERE root.isOpen = true AND runCount = 0
RETURN null AS workflowRunId, root.rootIssueId AS rootIssueId, null AS sourceTaskId, null AS routeId, null AS sourceStepId, 'a' AS targetStepId, 'task' AS targetStepKind, target.taskDefinitionId AS targetTaskDefinitionId

MATCH (run:WorkflowRun)-[:USES_DEFINITION]->(workflowDefinition:WorkflowDefinition)-[:HAS_TASK]->(definition:TaskDefinition)<-[:INSTANCE_OF]-(task:WorkGraphTask)-[:IN_RUN]->(run)
MATCH (route:WorkGraphTaskRoute)-[:ROUTES]->(evaluation:WorkGraphTaskEvaluate)-[:EVALUATES]->(result:WorkGraphTaskResult)-[:RESULT_FOR]->(task)
WHERE workflowDefinition.workflowDefinitionId = 'issue-lifecycle' AND workflowDefinition.digest = 'sha256:692a4ff45cfffcf1dc3462fcd3d904656a4c03efe7b598a09acdf368ce0d6645' AND definition.taskKey = 'g' AND route.workflowRunId = run.workflowRunId AND route.taskId = task.taskId AND route.resultId = result.resultId AND route.evaluationId = evaluation.evaluationId AND route.action = 'advance' AND route.transitionKind = 'next' AND route.outcome IS NULL AND route.targetStepId = 'h' AND route.targetStepKind = 'task' AND route.targetTaskDefinitionId = 'wgd-f61134fd0a90a7d569b9e1374ae5b005d924f9a1e95d3eb833979a5a83bc'
RETURN run.workflowRunId AS workflowRunId, task.rootIssueId AS rootIssueId, task.taskId AS sourceTaskId, route.routeId AS routeId, 'g' AS sourceStepId, 'h' AS targetStepId, route.targetStepKind AS targetStepKind, route.targetTaskDefinitionId AS targetTaskDefinitionId

MATCH (run:WorkflowRun)-[:USES_DEFINITION]->(workflowDefinition:WorkflowDefinition)
MATCH (wait:WorkGraphWait)-[:WAIT_IN_RUN]->(run)
MATCH (comment:WorkGraphRootIssueComment)-[:RESUMES]->(wait)
WHERE workflowDefinition.workflowDefinitionId = 'issue-lifecycle' AND workflowDefinition.digest = 'sha256:692a4ff45cfffcf1dc3462fcd3d904656a4c03efe7b598a09acdf368ce0d6645' AND wait.stepId = 'human' AND wait.event = 'root-issue-commented' AND comment.authorized = true
RETURN run.workflowRunId AS workflowRunId, wait.rootIssueId AS rootIssueId, wait.sourceTaskId AS sourceTaskId, wait.routeId AS routeId, 'human' AS sourceStepId, 'c' AS targetStepId, 'task' AS targetStepKind, 'wgd-95affedcc9b4f69dc6ac3aa3376245811348b9ee543a5072b44027d2aae1' AS targetTaskDefinitionId, comment.commentId AS commentId, comment.authorId AS authorId, comment.body AS body

RETURN run.workflowRunId AS workflowRunId, terminal.rootIssueId AS rootIssueId, route.taskId AS sourceTaskId, route.routeId AS routeId, terminal.stepId AS terminalStepId, terminal.outcome AS terminalOutcome
